Kochi works on the water. Containers move through the ICTT at Vallarpadam, refinery and petrochemical units run at Ambalamugal and Eloor, Cochin Shipyard turns out vessels, and the Infopark campuses at Kakkanad keep growing. All of it sits in a hot, humid, heavy-monsoon climate where a site office has to handle salt air and weeks of rain without falling apart. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer that builds steel units for exactly these conditions and ships them into Kochi from our Bangalore factory, around 550 km away on the Salem-Palakkad corridor. We are the maker, not a marketplace reseller - you can see the full lineup on the container office category we manufacture, and this page answers what Kochi buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Kochi

Port and logistics operators around Vallarpadam and the container yards use them as gate offices, documentation cabins and supervisor posts. Refinery, petrochemical and shipyard contractors use them as project offices and safety/permit rooms where a permanent building is not practical. Builders working across Kochi's fast-growing suburbs use them as construction site offices and watchman cabins. IT and campus projects in the Kakkanad belt use them as temporary admin offices during fit-out. Many of these buyers need a container site office for project teams that arrives finished and stands up to coastal weather from day one.

Kochi industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial and project belts:

  • Kalamassery industrial belt (683104) - one of Kochi's oldest manufacturing clusters (HMT, FACT neighbourhood, engineering units), strong demand for site and admin cabins.
  • KINFRA Export Promotion Industrial Park, Kakkanad (682030) - export and engineering units needing project offices and security cabins.
  • Cochin Special Economic Zone (CSEZ), Kakkanad (682037) - IT, electronics and export tenants; temporary offices during expansion and fit-out.
  • Vallarpadam / ICTT port-logistics belt (682504) - container terminal and logistics operations; gate, documentation and supervisor cabins.
  • Edayar Industrial Development Area, Binanipuram (683502) - the Eloor-Edayar chemical and process belt along the river, suited to rugged site offices and storage-cum-office units.

Sites outside these pockets - Ambalamugal, Aluva, Angamaly or the Cochin Port area - are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Kochi
10 ft10 x 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 x 8 ftSite office, documentation cabin, admin room
40 ft40 x 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated against heat and humidity
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with proper slope for heavy-monsoon drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated, sealed door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

For the base build, see a combined storage and office container option that pairs a lockable store with a finished cabin.

Customisation options

Kochi orders are usually customised for the climate and the use. We can add: extra weather-sealing for salt air and monsoon; AC provision and added insulation for IT and admin use; partition walls; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; heavier galvanised roofing and raised flooring for low-lying riverfront plots; and ramps or external steps. Units can be specified as a single relocatable office or built up for sites that need a tougher shell. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Kochi

We manufacture in Bangalore and dispatch to Kochi by road via the Salem-Palakkad corridor. Transit is typically 3-5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of Rs 3,000 applies where relevant - final transport is confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. The same route serves our other South pages, including container offices dispatched from Bangalore, so the line into Kerala is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST: 29ABBCS7101B1ZR. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1-2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20-25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price and after-sales. We supply across South India, including the Chennai container office page and container offices we build for Hyderabad.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Kochi depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, the level of weather-sealing for the coast, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Kochi?

Price depends on size, insulation, weather-sealing, partitions, electricals and fit-out. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification - share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Kochi?

We dispatch from our Bangalore factory, roughly 550 km away, with typical road transit of 3-5 days once the unit is built. We confirm the schedule at order stage based on your site location and access.

Are the units built for Kochi's monsoon and coastal conditions?

Yes. We use galvanised roofing with proper drainage slope, sealed openings and added weather protection for salt air and heavy rain. Tell us the site conditions and we configure the unit accordingly.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your Kochi container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
